$comment: The SpotLight tool list. Edit this file to add, change or remove tools; the site, the validator and the link checker all read it. Field guide: CONTRIBUTING.md

tools.name: VirusTotal
tools.desc: Analyze suspicious files, URLs, domains and IPs against 70+ antivirus scanners and threat intel blacklists.
tools.opsecNote: Uploaded files and URLs are shared with the security community, and paid users can download uploaded files. Search by hash instead of uploading anything sensitive.

tools.name: URLScan.io
tools.desc: Scan and analyze websites — browses the URL like a real user and records all activity, resources, and links.
tools.opsecNote: Scans are public by default and appear in the recent-scans feed. Set visibility to Unlisted or Private, and remember the scanner visits the site.

tools.name: Metadefender
tools.desc: Multi-scan files for malware using 40+ AV engines. Also supports file sanitization and CDR.
tools.opsecNote: Uploaded files may be retained and shared. Search by hash rather than uploading client files.

tools.name: URLhaus
tools.desc: Look up malicious URLs used for malware distribution. Part of the abuse.ch project.
tools.opsecNote: Searching is passive. Submitting a URL to URLhaus makes it public.

tools.name: URLVoid
tools.desc: Check URL reputation and history across multiple blacklist engines and safety services.
tools.opsecNote: Treat lookups as visible to others: recent scans can be listed on the site.

tools.name: Google Safe Browsing
tools.desc: Check if a URL is flagged in Google's Safe Browsing database for malware or phishing.

tools.name: Sucuri SiteCheck
tools.desc: Free remote website scanner that checks for malware, blacklisting, and outdated software.
tools.opsecNote: Sucuri's scanner fetches the site, so the target sees the request.

tools.name: SecurityHeaders.com
tools.desc: Scan any website and grade its HTTP security headers — CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options, and more.
tools.opsecNote: Connects to the site, and results appear in the public recent-scans list unless you tick 'Hide results'.

tools.name: SSL Labs
tools.desc: Deep analysis of SSL/TLS configuration for any web server. Grades certificate chain and cipher suites.
tools.opsecNote: Connects to the server, and results appear on the public boards unless you tick 'Do not show the results'.

tools.name: Netcraft Site Report
tools.desc: Website analysis: SSL/TLS details, HTTP security headers, hosting history, SPF/DMARC, and reputation.
tools.opsecNote: May fetch the site to build the report.

tools.name: Web-Check
tools.desc: All-in-one OSINT tool for any website: DNS, TLS, headers, open ports, linked domains, cookies, and more.
tools.opsecNote: Makes live requests to the site: DNS, headers, open ports and more.

tools.name: IsLegitSite
tools.desc: Website trustworthiness checker analyzing reputation, domain age, and public security signals.
tools.opsecNote: Checks the live site, so the target may see the request.

tools.name: URLQuery
tools.desc: URL scanner that detects exploit kits, malicious scripts, and suspicious network activity.
tools.opsecNote: Submissions are public by default, and the scanner visits the URL.

tools.name: Browserling
tools.desc: Open suspicious URLs in an isolated browser session — safe remote viewing without risk to your machine.
tools.opsecNote: Opens the site from Browserling's servers, so the target sees their IP rather than yours.

tools.name: AbuseIPDB
tools.desc: Community-driven database to report or look up IP addresses associated with hacking, spam, and abuse.
tools.opsecNote: Checking an IP is passive. Reports you file are public.

tools.name: Cisco Talos Intelligence
tools.desc: IP and domain reputation center from Cisco. Real-time threat detection and global threat intelligence data.

tools.name: OTX – AlienVault
tools.desc: Open Threat Exchange — community-powered threat intelligence sharing platform with IoC feeds.
tools.opsecNote: Searching is passive. Pulses you create are public by default.

tools.name: GreyNoise
tools.desc: Identifies IPs scanning the internet — reduces noise for analysts by separating benign scanners from threats.

tools.name: Pulsedive
tools.desc: Free threat intelligence platform with IoC enrichment. Search indicators, feeds, and threat context.
tools.opsecNote: Searching is passive. Submitting a new indicator for scanning makes Pulsedive probe it.

tools.name: Threat Intelligence Platform
tools.desc: Quick lookup for IPs and domains — combines WHOIS, DNS, and threat reputation in one view.
tools.opsecNote: Pulls live DNS and SSL data, which can contact the target.

tools.name: MITRE ATT&CK
tools.desc: Knowledge base of adversary tactics and techniques. Reference framework for threat modeling and detection.

tools.name: Cloudflare Radar
tools.desc: Internet traffic patterns, DDoS trends, and technology adoption data collected by Cloudflare globally.
tools.opsecNote: Traffic data is passive. Its URL Scanner is public by default and visits the site.

tools.name: CyberGordon
tools.desc: Threat intelligence aggregator querying 30+ sources for IOC reputation checks in a single lookup.
tools.opsecNote: Forwards your indicator to 30+ third-party services, so assume every one of them sees it.

tools.name: IPVoid
tools.desc: Check an IP address reputation across dozens of blacklist and reputation services at once.

tools.name: ThreatFox
tools.desc: Search a community database of malware indicators (IPs, domains, URLs and hashes) linked to known malware families.
tools.opsecNote: Searching is passive. Indicators you submit are public.

tools.name: OSINT Framework
tools.desc: Web-based mind-map of OSINT tools and resources organized by category. Great starting point for recon.

tools.name: GrayhatWarfare
tools.desc: Search open Amazon S3 buckets — find potentially exposed public cloud storage data.
tools.opsecNote: Viewing exposed files can be legally sensitive. Don't download data you aren't authorised to access.

tools.name: Wayback Machine
tools.desc: Internet Archive — browse historical snapshots of any website for OSINT and deleted content recovery.
tools.opsecNote: Browsing snapshots is passive. 'Save Page Now' makes the archive fetch the page, and the capture is public.

tools.name: Intelligence X
tools.desc: OSINT search engine and data archive for emails, domains, URLs, IPs, and breach data including dark web.
tools.opsecNote: Searches are tied to your account if you're logged in.

tools.name: ANY.RUN
tools.desc: Interactive online malware sandbox for DFIR/SOC investigations. Run samples live in a browser-based VM.
tools.opsecNote: Free-plan analyses are public: anyone can see the sample and results. Detonated samples also contact attacker infrastructure.

tools.name: Hybrid Analysis
tools.desc: Free malware analysis powered by CrowdStrike Falcon Sandbox. Cross-checks with VirusTotal.
tools.opsecNote: Submissions are public by default and shared with partners. Search by hash first.

tools.name: MalwareBazaar
tools.desc: Search and download confirmed malware samples by hash, family, or tag. Run by the abuse.ch community.
tools.opsecNote: Searching is passive. Uploaded samples are public and downloadable by anyone.

tools.name: Joe Sandbox
tools.desc: Deep malware analysis with behavioral analytics. Web-based sandbox with detailed execution reports.
tools.opsecNote: Free (Basic) analyses publish their reports. Never upload client documents.

tools.name: VirusTotal Graph
tools.desc: Visualize and explore relationships between files, URLs, domains, and IPs in VirusTotal's dataset.
tools.opsecNote: Graphs saved on a free account can be public.

tools.name: Shodan
tools.desc: Search engine for internet-connected devices — find exposed servers, IoT devices, webcams, and industrial systems.
tools.opsecNote: Searching is passive. On-demand scans (Shodan Scan) actively probe the target.

tools.name: Censys
tools.desc: Discover exposed servers and certificates across the internet. Used for attack surface enumeration.

tools.name: FullHunt
tools.desc: External attack surface discovery — find and enumerate your internet-exposed assets and services.

tools.name: LeakIX
tools.desc: Search engine for exposed services and data leaks across the internet. Indexes misconfigured systems.

tools.name: IPInfo.io
tools.desc: IP geolocation, ASN, and company details. Free tier covers 50k lookups per month.

tools.name: BGP.he.net
tools.desc: Hurricane Electric BGP toolkit — ASN lookup, BGP routing info, DNS records, and network analysis.

tools.name: Shodan Monitor
tools.desc: Monitor your own IP space on Shodan — get alerts when new devices or vulnerabilities appear.
tools.opsecNote: For monitoring your own IP ranges. Requires a free account.

tools.name: NVD – NIST
tools.desc: U.S. government repository of standards-based vulnerability data. Canonical CVE database with CVSS scores.

tools.name: Exploit-DB
tools.desc: Archive of public exploits and vulnerable software maintained by Offensive Security for research use.
tools.opsecNote: Downloaded exploit code can trip your own AV/EDR. Use a lab machine.

tools.name: CVE Details
tools.desc: Browse and search CVEs by product, vendor, or score. Useful for software vulnerability tracking.

tools.name: CIRCL CVE Search
tools.desc: Free API and web interface for CVE vulnerability data from CIRCL Luxembourg. Supports bulk queries.

tools.name: Vulners
tools.desc: Vulnerability database and search engine aggregating CVEs, exploits, and security advisories.

tools.name: Shodan CVEDB
tools.desc: Shodan's free CVE database. Look up vulnerabilities by CVE ID or by product.

tools.name: Have I Been Pwned
tools.desc: Check if your email address has appeared in a known data breach. Billions of records indexed.

email.label: Have I Been Pwned (paste it in)

tools.name: Pwned Passwords
tools.desc: Check individual passwords against billions of breach records using k-anonymity — your password is never sent.
tools.opsecNote: Only a partial hash leaves your browser, but never type a live production password into any website.

tools.name: MXToolbox
tools.desc: Free DNS lookups, MX record checks, blacklist monitoring, and email deliverability diagnostic tools.
tools.opsecNote: Queries the domain's DNS and mail servers live.

tools.name: DNSDumpster
tools.desc: Free domain research tool for DNS recon and host discovery. Maps DNS records and related subdomains.

tools.name: WHOIS Lookup
tools.desc: Look up domain registration details — registrar, creation date, name servers, and contact info.

tools.name: DomainTools WHOIS
tools.desc: Advanced WHOIS lookup with historical records, reverse IP, and domain ownership history.

tools.name: ViewDNS.info
tools.desc: Collection of DNS, WHOIS, and network tools: reverse IP, DNS propagation, traceroute, and more.
tools.opsecNote: Ping, traceroute and port-scan tools contact the target. The record lookups don't.

tools.name: Paul Jerimy Cyber Roadmap
tools.desc: Interactive security certification roadmap showing study paths across offensive, defensive, and governance domains.

tools.name: Nomi Sec CVE POCs
tools.desc: Automated aggregation tool that scans GitHub daily to collect Proof of Concept (PoC) code and exploits for newly discovered cybersecurity vulnerabilities.
tools.opsecNote: PoC code on GitHub is unvetted and sometimes malicious. Only run it in an isolated lab.
